description:
Texas rents have climbed 18% since 2021 — but these 10 towns still come in under $1,500 a month, all-in.

We ran the full budget for each city: rent, utilities, car insurance, and transportation. Every town on this list passes the test with real numbers from Apartment List, Zillow, and the U.S. Census Bureau. From East Texas pine forests to the Rio Grande Valley, these are the Texas cities where a single income still goes somewhere in 2026.

🔔 Subscribe: youtube.com/@InsideTexasTv

Sources: Apartment List Q1 2026 · Zillow March 2026 · Redfin January 2026 · U.S. Census Bureau 2025 · Valley Morning Star 2025 · KLTV 2025
